meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把 Mattermost 接入 NanoClaw：先探测你已有的 Mattermost 服务器（或让你创建本地评估服务器），再配置机器人账号、私信、文件和审批卡片，消息通过 WebSocket 收发。所有步骤需你确认且可重复执行。
howto.when: 当你要求添加 Mattermost 频道或机器人、把 Mattermost 接入 NanoClaw 时触发。技能会先探测服务器，不会自动帮你选服务器。

say.text: 帮我添加 Mattermost 机器人频道
say.note: 开始探测服务器并引导选择

say.text: 用我本地的 Mattermost 服务器接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 复用检测到的现有服务器

say.text: 创建一个 Mattermost 本地评估服务器
say.note: 会先说明要创建的容器和配置，征求同意

howto.what_en: Adds Mattermost to NanoClaw: probes for an existing server or offers a local one, then configures bot token, DMs, files, reactions, and interactive approval cards. Steps are re-runnable and need user approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a Mattermost channel/bot or connect Mattermost to NanoClaw. It first discovers servers; no automatic server selection.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost bot channel for me.
Use my local Mattermost server to connect NanoClaw.
Create a local Mattermost evaluation server.
say_en.note: Shows what will be created and asks approval first
